explorer.title: Discover events

organization.subtitle: Upcoming events and past highlights.
organization.emptyDescription: This organizer has no events on sale right now. Check back soon.

follow.followHint: Get one weekly email about their events.
follow.followingHint: Their events are in your weekly email. Press to unfollow.
follow.signInHint: Sign in to follow. We'll bring you back here.
follow.networkFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.

following.title: Following
following.description: The organizers and tags you follow. They all arrive in one weekly email.
following.suggestionsDescription: Organizers and tags you don't follow yet.
following.emptyDescription: Follow an organizer from their page, or a tag from an event, and their events arrive in one weekly email.
following.loadFailedTitle: We couldn't load what you follow
following.loadNetworkFailed: We couldn't reach the ticket service. Please check your connection and try again.
following.digestOnDescription: One email a week about everything below. Turn it off and you keep every follow — nothing here changes.
following.digestOffDescription: The weekly email is off. Everything you follow is still below and still yours; you just aren't being written to.
following.digestOnToast: The weekly digest is back on.
following.digestOffToast: The weekly digest is off. You still follow everything below.
following.digestNetworkFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.

unsubscribe.title: Turn off the weekly digest
unsubscribe.description: You'll stop getting the weekly email. Everything you follow stays exactly as it is — this only stops the mail.
unsubscribe.doneDescription: We won't send it again. Everything you follow is still yours, and you can turn the digest back on whenever you like.
unsubscribe.networkFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
unsubscribe.missingTokenDescription: Open the link from your email again, or turn the digest off from your account.

confirmConsent.title: Confirm your preferences
confirmConsent.description: You, or someone using your address, ticked one or more optional boxes at checkout. Nothing happens until it's confirmed here, from the inbox the message arrived in.
confirmConsent.doneDescription: Your choices are saved. You can change them from your account whenever you like, and every marketing email carries an unsubscribe link.
confirmConsent.nothingTitle: There was nothing left to confirm
confirmConsent.nothingDescription: This is already settled — either it was confirmed before, or you've since answered from your account. Nothing changed just now, and the preferences you have are the ones that stand.
confirmConsent.networkFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
confirmConsent.missingTokenDescription: Open the link from your email again, or set your preferences from your account.

event.limitReachedNote: This ticket type is limited to {limit} per person and you have reached yours. Nothing is sold out — this is only your own limit.
event.registrationClosed: Registration for this event has closed.
event.registrationUnavailable: Registration is not available right now.

success.title: You're going!
success.confirmedGeneric: Your payment was approved and your tickets are confirmed.

failed.unconfirmed: We couldn't finish confirming your payment. You haven't been charged, and no tickets were issued.
failed.retryHint: Your tickets weren't reserved, so if you'd still like to go, just start again.
failed.supportAlertTitle: Your payment may have gone through
failed.supportAlertBody: We couldn't record your tickets after the payment step. Please don't pay again — contact the event organizer and we'll sort it out.

stub.title: Confirm your payment

customerArea.refundRefusedToast: Your tickets are still valid — your refund could not be processed.
customerArea.refundPendingNote: We're confirming your refund with the payment provider. Your tickets stay valid until it goes through — check back in a few minutes.
